name: Despot4Despot: Have my Empire if I Can Have your Cold, Cruel Love!!
source:
Imperia Hali Fortessence aux Val-Regalia, daughter of Kaska and Hwyngarde, third of her name, and ninth empress of the Regalia Universum, the rightful demesne of humanity that rules from the Nebula Orion to the Cygnus Spur, lives a suffocating life on her ivory tower throne until she finally meets Justicia Eowyndel XI, Crown Princess of Helstorm, and her natural predator, eager to prey on the vulnerabilities of her prudish, sheltered and lonely existence.

[From [url=https://dianerds.itch.io/despot4despot]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
英佩莉娅·哈利·瓦尔·雷加利亚 (Imperia Hali Fortessence aux Val-Regalia)，卡斯卡 (Kaska) 和海温加德 (Hwyngarde) 的女儿，她的名字的第三位，也是帝王宇宙 (Regalia Universum) 的第九位女皇，统治着从猎户座星云到天鹅座马刺的人类合法领地，她在她的象牙塔王座上过着令人窒息的生活，直到她最终遇到了地狱风暴的王储公主贾斯蒂西亚·欧文德尔十一世 (Justicia Eowyndel XI) 和她的天敌，她渴望利用她拘谨、受庇护和孤独的存在中的脆弱性。

[来自[url=https://dianerds.itch.io/despot4despot]itch.io[/url]]
